use default

use ENTRY = (score: int, name: string)
use RANKER = (int, int, int, int) -> string

let competitors =
    [(score = 44, name = "Solomon"),
     (score = 42, name = "Jason"),
     (score = 42, name = "Errol"),
     (score = 41, name = "Garry"),
     (score = 41, name = "Bernard"),
     (score = 41, name = "Barry"),
     (score = 39, name = "Stephen")]

ties(entries: List[ENTRY]) -> Pipe[List[ENTRY]] is
    let tied = LIST[ENTRY]()

    for entry in entries do
        if tied.count > 0 /\ tied[0].score != entry.score then
            yield tied |> collect()

            tied.clear()
        fi

        tied.add(entry)
    od

    if tied.count > 0 then
        yield tied |> collect()
    fi
si

ranked(rank: RANKER) -> Pipe[string] is
    let ahead mut = 0
    let place mut = 0

    for tied in ties(competitors) do
        place = place + 1

        for member in 0..tied.count do
            yield "{rank(ahead, tied.count, member, place),5}  "
                  "{tied[member].score} {tied[member].name}"
        od

        ahead = ahead + tied.count
    od
si

standard(ahead: int, size: int, member: int, place: int) -> string =>
    "{ahead + 1}"

modified(ahead: int, size: int, member: int, place: int) -> string =>
    "{ahead + size}"

dense(ahead: int, size: int, member: int, place: int) -> string =>
    "{place}"

ordinal(ahead: int, size: int, member: int, place: int) -> string =>
    "{ahead + member + 1}"

fractional(ahead: int, size: int, member: int, place: int) -> string =>
    "{cast double(ahead + ahead + size + 1) / 2.0D:F1}"

let methods =
    [(name = "standard", rank = standard),
     (name = "modified", rank = modified),
     (name = "dense", rank = dense),
     (name = "ordinal", rank = ordinal),
     (name = "fractional", rank = fractional)]

methods |> each(method => (
    write_line("{method.name} ranking:")

    ranked(method.rank) |> each(line => write_line("  {line}"))

    write_line()
))
